findings.summary: Budget proof is false-green and misses required budget classes
findings.details: The focused observability test title claims model, Slack, storage, queue, and channel budget enforcement, but the assertions only cover modelTokens and slackRate. Required S13-T03 budget classes for model spend, storage caps, queue-depth caps, and channel-count caps can regress without a red focused test.

findings.summary: Operation policy implementation makes recovery generation checks self-confirming
findings.details: setPolicyInternal constructs the current policy from the request instead of durable current state. When expectedGeneration is supplied, current.generation is set to the same value before nextOperationPolicy checks it, so RecoveryGenerationMismatch is unreachable through the mutation path. Expiry fields are also stored/passed but not evaluated, leaving policy behavior hard to reason about as operations controls grow.
